source_or_authority: Issue #79 PR3 transparent initial threshold profile
rationale: Initial transparent rules for intraday flow classification. Thresholds are not investment decisions. Relative return and breadth are primary signals; concentration guards against single-stock distortion. Acceleration uses delta from previous snapshot. Threshold changes require explicit 👑Authority approval.

flow_state.STRONG_INFLOW: Relative return ≥2.5% vs benchmark, broad participation (≥60% rising), low concentration (≤40% from top constituent). Strong capital inflow signal.
flow_state.INFLOW: Relative return ≥1.0% vs benchmark, moderate participation (≥50% rising). Positive capital flow.
flow_state.MIXED: Neither clear inflow nor outflow. Default state when other conditions not met.
flow_state.OUTFLOW: Relative return ≤-1.0% vs benchmark, weak participation (≤40% rising). Capital leaving.
flow_state.STRONG_OUTFLOW: Relative return ≤-2.5% vs benchmark, very weak participation (≤30% rising), low concentration. Strong capital outflow.
flow_state.UNKNOWN: Data quality insufficient (STALE/PARTIAL) or classification rules not met.

acceleration_state.ACCELERATING: Flow strengthening vs previous snapshot: relative return delta ≥1.5%, breadth delta ≥10pts.
acceleration_state.DECELERATING: Flow weakening vs previous snapshot: relative return delta ≤-1.5%, breadth delta ≤-10pts.
acceleration_state.STABLE: Flow rate stable. Default when delta thresholds not met.
acceleration_state.UNKNOWN: No previous snapshot, data quality insufficient, or no explicit acceleration rules.

threshold_change_policy: Threshold modifications require explicit approval from 👑Sado Authority. Changes must be documented with rationale and version increment. This guards against post-hoc threshold fitting to justify past decisions.
usage: Supply this profile to scripts/intraday_subsector_classifier_harness.py classify_flow() and classify_acceleration() functions.
